cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8b8.team: 161 - St Johns - Sur La Table, 4713 River City Drive, Suite 109, Jacksonville, FL 32246
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8b8.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Sales Associateat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Actively engage customers, identify their needs, recommend relevant products or experiences, and leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture Sales & Business Performance · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Promote add-on sales and support events that grow store traffic and customer engagement. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Collaborate with team members to maintain a positive, inclusive, and high-performing store culture · Support onboarding of new associates by sharing product knowledge and best practices Operations & Compliance · Accurately and efficiently process transactions including sales, returns, and price checks using the POS system. · Assist in daily opening and closing procedures, floor replenishment, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work · Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. foundryforgood-foundry-for-good:ashbyhq:.description: Be Part of a Mission-Driven Team At Foundry for Good, we don’t just build businesses—we build businesses that do good. Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! Watch Our "Meet the Team" Video https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy Don't see an open role that quite fits your skillset? That's what the Wildcard is for! The Wildcard role isn't an open job opportunity that needs to be filled, instead it's a fun way to get your resume into our database and answer some questions so we can get to know you a bit. Because it isn't an open role, we aren't conducting live interviews for those who apply here (unless there is something open or coming open in the near future that might be a fit). When your resume gets to our database it gets tagged by our People team with keywords so that when we do open a new role we can search through our database for Wildcard applicants that might have relevant work experience or skills. We get hundreds of Wildcard submissions every month and our People team reviews every resume. Once you submit your resume, our People team will be in touch with any necessary next steps! WAGES - Hourly compensation is in $USD - We offer a competitive salary reflecting experience and skills - Aside from the base salary, there will also be an additional company contribution to go towards health insurance and additional benefits that you buy on your own - Target 42.5 billable hours per week - Additionally, you accrue Life Leave which can optionally be cashed in each year adding to your earnings MEET THE TEAM We currently have 50+ team members who live in the Philippines who have been fantastic team members and we’re excited to add new team members to this new role! Meet our PH Team Members https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy OTHER REQUIREMENTS Location - This is a work-from-home setup. - You would work during US EST Hours (Approx. 8 or 9 am to 5 or 6 pm EST) What Makes a Strong Candidate - Based in the Philippines with consistent availability for a long-term role. - Highly organized and outstanding organizational ability - A team player who has a willingness to learn and grow at a fast-pace - Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills - Strong academic background who graduated with an outstanding General Weighted Average - Individuals who graduate with a major that could be a good fit including Communications, Business Ad, Public Relations, Journalism, English, Public Administration, or other Liberal Arts and Business degrees As a small growing business, there are a few traits unique to our business that individuals should consider before applying. - You must love the idea of giving back to the community and nonprofits. There are thousands of jobs. If being involved in the success of nonprofits is something you’re truly passionate about, this could be a great role. - You must be extremely comfortable with change. As a small growing company, decisions can be made over a weekend and fully implemented by early the next week. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9922d9c1-ac74-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sage Enterprise Team Manager based in the United States. This leadership role combines people management, client success, project delivery, and commercial responsibility within a technology consulting environment. You’ll lead a team of service professionals while ensuring high-quality, profitable, and sustainable delivery across an assigned client portfolio. As a trusted client advisor, you’ll oversee relationships with senior stakeholders, drive satisfaction and retention, and identify opportunities for continued growth. You’ll also steer complex projects, balancing scope, budgets, resources, timelines, and business outcomes. The role calls for strong knowledge of enterprise applications, particularly Sage X3 and/or Sage 500, alongside sound consulting and business judgment. You’ll work closely with consulting and account leadership while coaching consultants and helping build a high-performing, engaged team. Success means delivering measurable client value while strengthening service revenue, team performance, and long-term customer relationships. Lead, coach, and manage a team of consultants, supporting utilization, performance, professional development, work-life balance, engagement, and retention. Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, performance conversations, career planning, and ongoing coaching while partnering with senior leadership on team development and resource allocation. Oversee key performance indicators including service revenue, billable hours, utilization, project performance, and other business metrics. Own and strengthen relationships with assigned clients through frequent communication with client teams and senior executives, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic point of contact. Ensure client projects, deliverables, and overall service experiences meet or exceed expectations, proactively addressing issues and maintaining strong satisfaction and retention. Coordinate with account managers and executives to understand client priorities, communicate project progress, and identify opportunities for additional services. Manage project revenue and budgets, ensuring engagements are appropriately scoped, commercially viable, and aligned with customer requirements. Support business development and pre-sales activities by qualifying opportunities, understanding requirements, preparing presentations and statements of work, developing pricing strategies, and helping close new engagements. Identify opportunities beyond current engagements and help expand service revenue within assigned accounts. Direct and steer day-to-day execution of client projects, ensuring delivery remains on time, within budget, and at the required quality level. Provide guidance to consulting teams on project issues, resource needs, and client challenges, escalating matters appropriately when required. Monitor project status, business metrics, timesheets, invoices, and delivery performance, providing regular updates to consulting leadership. Maintain expert-level knowledge of Sage X3 and/or Sage 500, relevant ERP solutions, add-on products, consulting methodologies, and applicable client-industry trends. Continuously identify ways to improve client solutions, team capabilities, operational processes, and service profitability. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, quality assurance, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred. 5+ years of experience working with technical applications or equivalent experience, supported by a strong understanding of consulting and process methodologies. Proven consulting background with experience delivering complex technical solutions within defined timelines and budgets. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9163ead-2423-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager (RPA & AI Delivery) based in India. This role offers the opportunity to lead end-to-end delivery of RPA, AI, Intelligent Automation, and digital transformation initiatives for global customers. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across business analysis, architecture, development, QA, and delivery. The position combines project governance, client engagement, financial oversight, and delivery excellence. You will have significant ownership over timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and quality. The environment is fast-paced and collaborative, with exposure to emerging automation and AI technologies. This is an ideal opportunity for a structured, client-focused project leader who enjoys turning complex initiatives into successful outcomes. Lead projects through the complete lifecycle, from initiation and planning through delivery, deployment, hypercare, and closure, ensuring scope, timelines, budget, quality, and deliverables remain on track. Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, roadmaps, resource requirements, and delivery strategies while coordinating dependencies across multiple workstreams. Serve as the primary client contact during project execution, leading kick-offs, status meetings, steering committees, executive presentations, and escalation management. Coordinate cross-functional teams including solution architects, developers, business analysts, QA professionals, delivery managers, and business stakeholders. Monitor project health, KPIs, milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues, maintaining RAID logs and proactively implementing mitigation plans. Prepare weekly status reports, executive dashboards, project health reports, governance documentation, and leadership updates in accordance with PMO standards. Manage project budgets, effort utilization, burn rates, forecasts, resource productivity, change requests, and scope adjustments. Facilitate Agile ceremonies where applicable, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, while supporting UAT, production deployment, and hypercare activities. Drive continuous improvement across delivery processes, quality standards, governance practices, and project execution. Manage vendors, stakeholders, and customer expectations while resolving conflicts, escalations, and delivery challenges effectively. Support automation and digital transformation initiatives by applying an understanding of RPA, AI, APIs, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and software development lifecycles. Measure project success through delivery timeliness, customer satisfaction, budget adherence, resource utilization, quality, risk resolution, governance compliance, and stakeholder engagement. Requirements: 4–6 years of experience in IT Project Management, preferably managing software implementation, digital transformation, RPA, AI, automation, or enterprise technology projects. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent master's degree is preferred. Proven experience managing projects end to end, including planning, scheduling, scope, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, change management, governance, and delivery. Strong understanding of SDLC and practical knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies. Exposure to RPA, Intelligent Automation, AI, Generative AI, or digital transformation projects; experience with UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or Microsoft Power Automate is an advantage. Basic understanding of APIs, SQL, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and business process automation concepts. Experience working with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Asana. superiorexecutiveandlegalrecruiting-supe.title: Senior Litigator
superiorexecutiveandlegalrecruiting-supe.description: Prestigious Century City based employment firm is looking for a senior litigator with at least 5 years of class action and/or PAGA litigation experience to join the firm’s litigation team. The firm is one of the leading plaintiff-only labor and consumer law firms in California, recognized for developing law on numerous cutting-edge issues in wage and hour and consumer law. The firm fiercely litigates on behalf of its clients and has obtained over $100,000,000 in relief for employees and consumers. This is a senior or partner level position and the right candidate needs to know how to run a docket and manage a team of attorneys. This can be a fully remote position and the firm offers a competitive compensation package that includes salary commensurate with experience + quarterly bonuses, 401(k) plan, generous paid time-off, medical, dental and vision insurance and opportunities for advancement and professional growth. Must be licensed and in good standing in CA and have a superior academic background or direct relevant experience.
